name: Skeleton
layerWhy: It holds the shape of content that is coming; the content is someone else's.
promise: This is where content will be, and this is its shape.
expectation: Blocks the size and shape of the rows, text and pictures to come.
evidence: It sits inside a container marked aria-busy, and is hidden from assistive technology.
behaviour: Shimmers slowly; still under reduced motion.
context: Lists and pages whose shape is known before their data.
relationships: It mirrors the real row: an avatar and two lines become a circle and two lines.
accessibility: aria-hidden; the container's aria-busy is what is heard.
failures: Never a shape that doesn't match what arrives.
dont: A skeleton when the data is already there.
